body.name: Auditable full-neighborhood exposure diagnostic for \(\texttt{szonszein/interference}\) version \(0.1.0\)
body.construction: \(\Phi(G,B,D,\alpha,L^{\mathrm{pkg}},L^{\mathrm{ref}})\) takes both the externally returned output of \(\texttt{make\_exposure\_map\_full\_neighborhood}\) and the independently recomputed target labels. It first checks \(N_G[i]=B_l\) for every \(i\in B_l\). Failure of this graph check returns \(\texttt{graph-reject}\) with the first crossing neighborhood or nonclique witness; this is the branch for overlapping-neighborhood inputs. On a valid unequal-clique graph, it checks \(L^{\mathrm{pkg}}=\mathsf E_{\mathrm{pkg}}^{0.1.0}(G,Z)\), \(L^{\mathrm{ref}}=\mathsf E_{\mathrm{ref}}(B,Z)\), and then the coordinatewise equality \(L^{\mathrm{pkg}}=L^{\mathrm{ref}}\). Any failed equality returns \(\texttt{label-mismatch}\) and the first unequal coordinate. Only after all checks pass does \(\Phi\) compute \(\overline Y_l^{\mathrm{obs}}(D)\) and return \((r_l,q_l,w_l,A_l,C_l)_{l=1}^L\), \(S\), \(M\), \(\omega_\alpha\), \(\rho_\alpha\), and \(I_{\mathrm{HT},\alpha}(D)\); both rejection branches suppress the confidence output.
